verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a human-readable API Reference and a markdown rendering of that page for AI agents, but nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. A markdown docs page is an adjacent documentation feature, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
